sloka: स धर्मः परमस्तेषां वैश्यशूद्रं समागमत् ।पूजां च सर्ववर्णानां शूद्राश्चक्रुर्विशेषतः ।। ७.७४.२१ ॥
transliteration: sa dharmaḥ paramasteṣāṁ vaiśyaśūdraṁ samāgamat ।pūjāṁ ca sarvavarṇānāṁ śūdrāścakrurviśeṣataḥ ।। 7.74.21 ॥

translations.english: That supreme righteousness, which was previously universal, now reached the Vaiśyas and Śūdras, and the Śūdras, in particular, began to perform worship for all castes.
